stem:
This bar graph shows historical trends in the U.S. work force.

Percent of Men and Women in the U.S. Labor Force, 1950–2010

The trend illustrated in this graph led to a demand to pass laws —

options.label: A
options.text: guaranteeing gender equality in the workplace

options.label: B
options.text: limiting the use of merit-based exams in the workplace

options.label: C
options.text: prohibiting union membership based on gender

visual_elements: bar graph showing percent of men and women in the U.S. labor force from 1950 to 2010
